usagePrompt: TWAP algorithmic execution. Adds a TWAP panel to the order form that works the order over a chosen duration with taker or maker placement, instead of sending it all at once. Install: add this package to your app and pass registerTwapExec() to OrderlyAppProvider's `plugins` prop. Config: set globalThis.TWAP_SERVER_URL to the execution backend endpoint. The plugin auto-detects the active symbol and account from the Orderly SDK context; no broker configuration is required. Supported on shared markets (PERP_<BASE>_USDC); broker-exclusive markets are not supported and the panel says so in place of the form.
